hook.name: UniswapV4Hook
hook.description: Gates pool initialization and liquidity additions as one-time events per token. In afterSwap, reverts buy-side swaps (non-zeroForOne) for tx.origin addresses not in a deployer-controlled allowlist when the timeBased flag is set for the token; any address can enable this buy-blocking by calling finiteAddr(). Exhibits honeypot and liquidity-locking mechanics.
